summary: StoneBridge Acquisition II Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K disclosing that it entered into a waiver with Scieniti LLC, an affiliate of its sponsor. Scieniti agreed to irrevocably waive monthly administrative services fees of $10,000 for all periods from October 1, 2025, until the earlier of the initial business combination or liquidation. No deal terms, prices, or strategic actions are present. This is a routine administrative agreement modification, not a special situation, so it is mapped to 'None'.
